name: serverless-remote
description: Routes Codex file and command operations into an active Serverless Remote SSH workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Safely route Codex into Serverless Remote SSH.
interface.longDescription: Discovers the active Serverless Remote SSH VS Code window, binds it to a Codex session, and prevents local tools from modifying a virtual remote workspace.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and update the active Serverless Remote project.
Run tests in my active Serverless Remote workspace.
